description: Lean Canvas Generator — AI Lean Canvas (Ash Maurya) for a startup or product idea: top 3 problems with existing alternatives, customer segments and early adopters, unique value proposition and high-level concept, solution, channels, revenue streams, cost structure, key metrics, unfair advantage - plus riskiest assumptions ranked 1-5 and cheap experiments with metric, pass threshold and duration. Offline checks flag empty blocks, a copyable unfair advantage, a long UVP and problem/solution mismatch. No invented traction or stats. Includes markdown. Param idea=, optional audience=. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

idea.description: e.g. A marketplace where neighbors rent out camping gear to each other for weekend trips

name: ai_lean_canvas
